hard_stops: Targeted real-world hate speech or slurs based on race, ethnicity, religion, disability, sexual orientation, or gender identity
Real named living individuals targeted with malicious defamation or doxxing
Real community or Discord members targeted by their personal username
Any minors in violent, abusive, or sexual contexts
Genuine self-harm, suicide encouragement, or dangerous DIY instructions
Actual copyrighted script plagiarism (word-for-word stolen full scenes)
allowed_and_encouraged: Authentic internet swearing, profanity, and screaming ('fk you', 'what the fk', 'bitch', 'shut the fk up', 'you're cooked', 'lmao gtfo') for raw comedic realism and character voice
Trending memes, viral moments, and current pop-culture formats actively squeezed to maximize views, engagement, and retention
High variety of non-Discord themes: gaming tournaments, courtroom dramas, reality shows, corporate disasters, school projects, news broadcasts, world summits, movie parodies
Public figures and internet archetypes (e.g. 'the orange-guy-in-chief', 'the nuke guy', 'crypto bro', 'rage-quitting streamer', 'sigma grindset coach') as satirical character engines
Extreme character clashes, high-volume panic, and unhinged escalating arguments
